updateRecovery.title: ScholarSeed update recovery
updateRecovery.message: All update protection processes have stopped unexpectedly. Save your work, restart your computer, then open ScholarSeed again to retry recovery. Your existing data has been retained. This dialog will not restart your computer.

admissionRecovery.title: ScholarSeed startup recovery
admissionRecovery.detail: The update may still be in progress, or startup security checks did not pass. The workbench has not started, update records have been retained, and the data location has not changed. Wait until installation has finished, then retry. If this continues, copy the diagnostics and contact support.

browserDownload.recoveryTitle: A browser download needs your attention
browserDownload.recoveryDetail: The downloaded file is retained at {{path}} until you choose a safe folder or delete it.
browserDownload.manualRecoveryDetail: Automatic recovery is unavailable. Open the folder and move the retained file at {{path}}, or delete it.
browserDownload.recoveryFailed: Could not save the download; the retained file was not deleted

startup.title: ScholarSeed startup
startup.failed: ScholarSeed could not start. Copy this message when reporting the problem. Startup diagnostics may not have been saved.

reasons.permission_denied: Access was denied or the update directory permissions could not be trusted. Do not reset AppData permissions; report this error for investigation.
reasons.policy_invalid: The launcher's embedded policy is invalid. Reinstall from a trusted installer.
reasons.deadline: Startup timed out. Please retry and report the error if it persists.
reasons.startup_failed: Startup stopped unexpectedly. Please retry and report the error if it persists.

stages.components: Preparing application components. First startup may take a few minutes…

startup.componentFailed: Could not prepare application components. Check your connection and available disk space, then retry.

installer.uninstallIncomplete: The previous uninstall has not finished, or the installation directory is incomplete: {{path}}. Click OK in the old uninstaller and wait for it to exit and finish cleanup, then run Setup again. If this persists, contact support; do not manually delete unknown files.

installer.risk: Ancestor folders of {{path}} allow other local accounts to change some contents or permissions, which may affect ScholarSeed's security. The default installation location is recommended. If you continue, the installer protects only ScholarSeed's own folder and does not change ancestor folder permissions.
installer.riskSilent: Silent installation does not automatically accept directory risks. Review them first; use --accept-directory-risk only if you understand and accept them. This option does not bypass the private installation root permission requirement.
installer.riskQuestion: Do you understand these risks and still want to continue installing? The default is No.

installer.riskAccess: An ancestor folder ACL grants other local accounts or groups permissions that may affect the installation location.
installer.preparing: Preparing the application. This window will close when installation is complete.
installer.migration: ScholarSeed 202610091639 was found. Installation will remove the old program and keep your research data and data folder setting. Close ScholarSeed before continuing.
installer.migrating: Removing the previous program and installing ScholarSeed…
installer.migrationUnsupported: This older installation cannot be migrated automatically. Only the original release 202610091639 is supported. No old installation has been removed.
installer.migrationRunning: Close ScholarSeed and its background tasks, then retry installation.
installer.migrationIncomplete: The previous program was removed, but the new installation did not complete. Your data folder setting is retained. Run this installer again to finish.
installer.migrationIdentity: Approve administrator access using the same Windows account. Migration cannot continue with a different administrator account; the old installation was not removed.
installer.legacyRemoval:
An older installation could not be prepared for automatic migration. Location: {{path}}.

{{detail}}

This setup has not removed the old installation. New and old clients cannot be kept together. If the official uninstaller is trusted, uninstall the old version using Windows Settings and keep personal data. If it is missing, changed or cannot be verified, contact support with these details; do not run it as administrator or delete data/registry entries to bypass this check.

After uninstalling, choose Retry to check again. Cancel closes Setup.
